about: The review of each map's exact bytes (docs/decisions/0017-a-map-change-carries-a-review-of-its-bytes.md). tools/check-map-review.py fails any map whose sha256 is not the one recorded here.

exemption.reason: Not reviewed: this is the first mapping of the Rules Glossary's fifteen conditions and it has not had the blind second mapping 0014 requires, so nothing has compared it with a second reading of pp. 177-191. The map is trial evidence for #8 and is not used for anything downstream: there is no map-package.json, nothing packs it, and no engine consumes it. `legacy` is the wrong word and is used deliberately, for the reason examples/srd-52-combat/README.md finding 8 already recorded — it is the only exemption kind that names a tracking issue, and `non-semantic` needs a reviewed map to depart from, which a new map does not have. A blind second mapping is owed before this map is packed or built from, and it should look hardest at three things this trial's own report names as unsettled: whether the fifteen hub entries are rules or a mapper's scaffolding, whether the twelve ambiguity verdicts are the right twelve (the rate, 18% of in-scope entries, is below trial 7's 27% and the report argues the genre explains it), and whether the 107 crossReferences items are complete, since the SRD's declared pointerPhrases detect none of the 51 condition-to-condition references in the slice and so oblige none of them.
